name: JSON Formatter
summary: Beautify, format, and minify JSON entirely in your browser.
description: Paste messy JSON and get a clean, indented result instantly. Forge formats and minifies JSON locally—nothing is uploaded to a server.

faqs.question: Does Forge upload my JSON?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser with the built-in JSON parser.

faqs.question: Can I minify JSON too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Minify or set Indent to Minified to remove whitespace.

faqs.question: What if my JSON is invalid?
faqs.answer: You will see a parse error. Fix the syntax, or use JSON Validator for a clearer line/column hint.

faqs.question: Is an account required?
faqs.answer: No. Forge tools work without signup.
